review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new definition is `PredictableMesh.repair`. It is the pointwise `limUnder atTop` of the mesh samples `sample u n t ω`, and `sample` is defined in the repo's PredictableMeshApproximation.lean. I found no Mathlib definition of a "repaired version" of a process, so `repair` is a thin, purpose-specific wrapper over Mathlib's `limUnder`. Its theorems use Mathlib's `IsStronglyPredictable`, `StronglyAdapted` and `StronglyMeasurable.limUnder`, so the file does not introduce a competing predictability notion. The main theorem is a statement with no new structures. I found no independent duplicate concept to consolidate, so I abstain. I did not check that `sample` itself has no Mathlib counterpart, because it is defined outside this file.
